about.heading: DN Mobiles — Port Augusta's Local Phone Repair Shop
about.description: DN Mobiles is a trusted local mobile repair shop serving Port Augusta and the surrounding South Australian community. We fix phones, iPads and tablets with quality parts, honest pricing and quick turnaround.
about.paragraph1: From cracked screens and worn-out batteries to back glass damage — we handle mobile repairs for all major brands, including iPhone, Samsung, Google and more. Every device gets a free inspection before any work begins, so you know exactly what's wrong and what it will cost.
about.paragraph2: Looking for an affordable phone that works like new? Ask about our refurbished phones — tested, repaired and professionally serviced in-house.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions.
faq.subheading: Find answers to common questions about our repair services.

items.q: How can I book a repair?
items.a: You can call us at 0420 655 514, email dnmobilerepairspa@gmail.com, send a WhatsApp message, or use the booking form on this website. We also take walk-ins during opening hours.
Yes! Every device brought in gets a completely free inspection & diagnostics — no hidden fees. We tell you exactly what's wrong and what it will cost before any work begins.

items.q: Can I get a quote before the repair?
items.a: Absolutely. After the free inspection you receive an honest, itemised quote before any work begins — no obligation to proceed.

items.q: How long does a screen replacement take?
items.a: Most screen repairs are completed the same day, often much faster. iPad and tablet repairs typically take 1–2 days depending on parts availability. Contact us for an exact estimate.
We repair all major phone brands including iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, Oppo and more, as well as iPads and popular tablets like Samsung Galaxy Tab.

items.q: What a typical repair takes and how it works — what is the process?
items.a: Book a free inspection → we diagnose the fault → you approve the quote → we repair with quality parts → we test everything → you collect your device. It's that simple.
We use quality replacement parts suited to your device and budget. Options may be discussed during your free inspection.
We accept cash, bank transfer and PayID. Contact us if you'd like to arrange a specific payment option.
Both walk-ins and appointments are welcome — whatever suits you. Walk-ins get free diagnostics on the spot; booking ahead means a technician is ready when you arrive.
Yes! We stock quality refurbished phones that have been professionally serviced and tested. Contact us to see what's currently available.

Pricing depends on the device brand and model — exact prices are always confirmed after your free inspection. As a guide, screen replacements start from $99, battery replacements from $99, back glass from $199, and iPad/tablet repairs from $199. You'll always get an exact quote before any work begins.

items.q: Is there a warranty on repairs?
items.a: Yes — we provide a warranty on our repairs. The exact coverage depends on the repair type and part used, and we'll confirm the details with you when you book.
Bring your device in for a free inspection — we'll assess the damage and let you know what's possible before any cost.
In many cases yes. Back up beforehand if possible — we can help during the repair. Data recovery success depends on the damage.
Yes! We happily accept mail-in repairs from outside Port Augusta. Message us on WhatsApp or call 0420 655 514 and we'll arrange postage details.
DN Mobiles is located at 18 Domeyer Court, Port Augusta SA 5700. Call 0420 655 514 for directions.
We're open 7 days a week, 8 AM to 8 PM — only closed on some public holidays. Call or message us to confirm before you visit.
Yes — cases, screen protectors, chargers and more. Ask in store.

items.q: My phone won't turn on — what do I do?
items.a: Bring it in for a free inspection. Common causes include battery or charging problems — most are fixable affordably.

items.q: Do you repair devices still under manufacturer warranty?
items.a: Some third-party repairs may affect your manufacturer warranty. We'll always advise you first during the free inspection.

items.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
items.a: Yes — free pickup and drop-off within Port Augusta. Message us to schedule a collection that suits you.

items.q: Can I repair my tablet or iPad too?
items.a: Absolutely — we repair iPads and all popular tablets, including screens, batteries and charging issues. All brands welcome.
